lead: Use whenever a change touches what a user, integrator, or operator sees, for any README being written or cut down, when a module or a call between modules is added in a repo that keeps a system map, and to draw a system, a feature, or an idea as an animated figure or a Miro frame: the docs, the map, and the pictures move in the same change as the code.

sync.cue: bring user docs level with a diff before it is committed

audit.cue: are the user docs current: report only

shots.cue: the docs screenshot harness: add, retake, repair a shot

readme.cue: write or cut down a README

init.cue: adopt the user-docs checks in a repo

map-sync.cue: a code change moved the system map or its board

miro.cue: draw or update a frame, fix overlaps, pull layout back

map-init.cue: give a repo a system map generated from its code

browser-setup.cue: the live check has no browser tools or cannot reach Miro

figure.cue: a description or a feature into an animated figure

stills.cue: a figure's stills, beat strip, or GIF for a README
